posts.what: A dark hut with a glass lens stands on the south-west meadow; a traced still from inside shows the friends and meadow upside down in the lens with the sky beneath them.
posts.recipe: new permanent optical prop, traced still of the island seen through it
posts.shared: a new prop on the meadow that shows a picture of the island

posts.what: A white sheet drops past a floating islet and a TV toward the shore while the camera follows it down, then the camera ends up pressed into a green glassy blob and the dark base of a plant, so the landing on the grass is not readable.
posts.recipe: one simulated object falls, camera follows it down
posts.shared: a single thing drops from the sky with the camera following it

posts.what: From a fixed high view a white sheet drifts slowly down past a bush and settles onto a brown plank among flowers, and the film stops there; nothing else on the island changes.
posts.recipe: one simulated object falls slowly onto a surface, static camera
posts.shared: the same falling-paper simulation, a sheet dropping and landing
